title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_3
doc_notes: This file contains multiple FBI and Air Force intelligence reports regarding various flying disc sightings and investigations, including the debunked Maury Island incident. / This document is an FBI case file containing reports and correspondence regarding flying disc sightings, including investigations and internal policy discussions.

encounters.summary: F. M. Johnson reported seeing a formation of round, oval-shaped flying discs near Mt. Adams on June 24, 1947, while prospecting.
encounters.entity_appearance: Round, 30 feet in diameter, oval-shaped, bright top surface, tail object like a clock hand.
encounters.quote: they were Round about 30 foot in dimater tapering sharply to a point in the head end in an oval shape.

encounters.summary: Three enlisted men at Harmon Field, Guam, reported seeing two small, crescent-shaped objects traveling at high speed on a zig-zag course.
encounters.entity_behavior: Traveling at twice the speed of a fighter plane, zig-zag course.
encounters.quote: small, crescent shaped and traveling at a speed twice that of a fighter plane

encounters.summary: Harold Dahl and Fred Crisman claimed that flying discs dropped debris on their boat near Maury Island, killing a dog and damaging the boat.
encounters.entity_appearance: Round, flattened, 100 feet across, 25-foot center hole, portholes.
encounters.quote: Five flying discs came down out of the clouds and circled slowly around the bay

encounters.summary: Ray A. Switzer reported seeing a metallic, rocket-shaped object crash with a puff of smoke near Placerville, California.
encounters.entity_appearance: Rocket-shaped, 4-6 feet long, 10-14 inches wide, bright chromium color.
encounters.quote: object, four to six feet in length, ten to fourteen inches wide, and of a metal color, bright like highly polished chromium.

encounters.summary: R. J. Madden and two others reported seeing a bright, fluttering disc hovering and then disappearing at high speed.
encounters.entity_appearance: Bright disc, 5 feet in diameter, 3-4 inches thick, polished nickel appearance.
encounters.entity_behavior: Hovering, fluttering, then disappeared at high speed.
encounters.quote: bright disc hovering and fluttering in the air

encounters.summary: Kenneth Arnold observed nine disc-like objects flying in formation near Mt. Rainier, Washington, at high speed.
encounters.entity_appearance: saucer-like, disc-shaped, no tails, bright reflection
encounters.entity_behavior: flying in formation, swerving, high speed
encounters.quote: I observed a chain of nine peculiar looking aircraft

encounters.summary: A.C. Urie and his two sons observed a disc-shaped object flying through Snake River Canyon.
encounters.entity_appearance: oblong, inverted pie-plate, light sky blue, red tubular fiery glow
physical_effects: trees spun around as if in a vacuum
encounters.quote: It was all one color—sort of a light sky blue with a red, tubular fiery glow

encounters.summary: Byron B. Savage observed a disc-shaped object over Oklahoma City.
encounters.entity_appearance: elliptical then perfectly round and flat, frosty white
encounters.quote: it appeared perfectly round and was flat

encounters.summary: Two army officers observed a spherical object traveling at high speed near Fort Richardson, Alaska.
encounters.entity_behavior: traveling against the wind, high speed
encounters.quote: The object appeared to be shaped like a sphere

encounters.summary: R.J. Madden and two others observed a disc hovering and then disappearing at high speed near Canyon Ferry, Montana.
encounters.quote: a bright disc hovering and fluttering in the air
